principles: Derive shared identity from a canonical root, never a per-worktree root
Digest logical (repo-relative) inputs, keep physical paths as non-digested provenance
Version envelopes and migrate rather than hard-fail legacy evidence
drivers: Fail-closed for genuinely different commands preserved

options.name: git-common-dir
pros: single source of truth for linked worktrees
cons: requires a git call; needs a non-git fallback

rationale: git --git-common-dir is the canonical shared root for all linked worktrees of one repo; fall back to projectRoot when not a git repo, preserving plain-repo behavior byte-identically.

preMortem.mitigation: fall back to projectRoot (current behavior) when git-common-dir is unavailable

preMortem.trigger: digest shape change rejects old receipts
preMortem.mitigation: versioned envelope accepts old-shape receipts during migration

preMortem.consequence: false digest match hides a real change
preMortem.mitigation: only cwd is made relative; command/args/env/shell stay verbatim in the digest
